newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Pharma Vision takes 10 pct stake in Tularik.
newsitem.headline: Pharma Vision takes 10 pct stake in Tularik.

text.p: Pharma Vision 2000 AG said it had acquired a 10 percent stake in U.S. genetic technology company Tularik Inc for $33 million.
Tularik planned an initial public offer of shares in 1997, Pharma Vision said in a statement.
It released a statement from Tularik, headquartered in South San Francisco, saying the transaction was part of a private placement of preferred stock that raised more than $60 million.
The statement described the deal as the largest-ever private company financing in the biotech sector.

"This global financing includes investors in the United States, Europe and Japan," it said. "The major investor is Pharma Vision 2000 AG. Other investors in Tularik's preferred stock include JT Inc, Lombard Odier and funds advised by Mehta and Isaly."
"With this investment in Tularik, Pharma Vision is increasing its exposure to the genetic technology sector," the listed Swiss investment vehicle said.
The knowledge it gained from Tularik would help it judge developments in pharmaceutical sector and guide its investment strategy, it said.
Tularik focuses on developing therapeutics which act through the regulation of gene expression, the company said.
It is developing programmes to deal with inflammation, viral diseases, hypercholesterolemia, immune disorders, bacterial diseases and obesity.
